Besides, the results of harmonic forecasting achieves the purpose of the harmonic forecasting, and the harmonic value is evaluated using the ways of harmonic evaluation. It provides a theoretical reference for the harmonic evaluation on the influence of railway, which can also make an improvement of the power quality in power network.

articleTitle: The amelioration of control strategy of VSC-MTDC based on voltage droop control
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The voltage stability of VSC-MTDC depends on the balance between the input power flow and the output power flow. It is significant to optimize power distribution among converters and enhance system voltage stability by adapting the converter voltages to the deviation of the power flow with adequate multi-terminal voltage control strategy. Summarizing the characteristics of the three existing control strategies, including the master-slave control, the voltage margin control and the voltage droop control, an improved control strategy based on voltage droop control is proposed. The theoretical analysis shows that this control strategy could significantly ease the DC bus bar voltage deviation when power flow through converters changes intensely, as well as adapt voltage to the change and distribute the power flow automatically when converter power flow merely changes slightly.

articleTitle: Series phase-shifted full-bridge DC-DC converters in a new type of full scale photovoltaic DC power generation system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: At present, traditional photovoltaic power plants use AC system as the main network structure, which is mature and reliable. However, AC structure has obvious disadvantages. On the one hand, there are a lot of traditional low-voltage converters in the main grid. On the other hand, the line loss increases a lot due to the low line voltage of AC system. In the investigation we described here, we proposed a new type of full scale Photovoltaic DC Power Generation System. The station bus in the system was high-voltage DC bus and made of the high-power phase-shifted full-bridge DC-DC modules to realize the maximum power point tracking. And the high voltage of DC bus was built by the series of DC-DC converter modules. The DC bus structure was helpful to decrease the line loss. At the same time, the phase-shift converter, to which the technology of Zero Voltage Switch can apply, help to reduce the switching loss and increase the operation efficiency. This paper concerned about the series Phase-shifted full-bridge DC-DC converters in the new type of full scale Photovoltaic DC Power Generation System. In the investigation we discussed here, we simulated a single 100kW Phase-shifted full-bridge module to trace the maximum power point. We focused on the distribution of capacitor voltage in series DC-DC modules. At the same time, much research about transition process and response when some modules worked out or the PV characteristics changed had been done in the paper.

articleTitle: Maximum power point performance tracking comparison between incremental conductance with perturb and observe algorithms in photovoltaic power systems
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Electric power from solar energy technologies is gaining great and important uses because of cleanness, free, no noise and little maintenance. Their characteristic output power depends on fluctuating climatic conditions like temperature, cloud cover, and irradiance. Since climate is not always uniform, maximum power point tracking techniques are used in solar power systems to extract maximum power from photovoltaic systems. In this paper, voltage and current data from a 50 W stand-alone photovoltaic module located in Rwamagana district, Rwanda were recorded and used to compare the performance between incremental conductance algorithm with perturb and observe algorithm for maximum power point tracking. The maximum power point of 12.044 W was achieved at 15 hours for the incremental conductance algorithm. Both I-V and P-V characteristics of PV system show n-shaped nonlinear conductance and n-shaped nonlinear current characteristic curves. An equation was developed for the dissipative saw-tooth wave irradiance characteristic curve, at fairly constant temperatures, in the study.

articleTitle: Optimal control for a boiler-turbine system via galerkin method
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: It is challenging to control boiler-turbine system in thermal power plant because of its large-scale nonlinearity, multi-variable couplings and physical constraints. This paper aims to design an optimal controller for a second-order boiler-turbine unit via a real-time GaleRkin optimal control strategy so as to achieve appropriate tracking performance. It will show that the proposed real-time Galerkin optimal control strategy can efficiently track the change of load in large-scale load range while maintaining physical constraints on both control inputs and outputs. Some simulations are conducted to validate our conclusions.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment of relay protection system considering different protection configuration schemes
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The hardware reliability of the microcomputer protection device has been greatly improved, and the different protection principles and configuration schemes have become the main factors affecting the reliability. First, this paper summaries the configuration of primary equipment and its relay protection systems. Second, the Markov state space method is used to establish the integrated model of the primary device and its protection systems according to the common configurations of the power system and on the basis of the system state division. Finally, this paper evaluates the reliability of different protection configurations. The method proposed in this paper can calculate the reliability of the protection system composed of different principles or different manufacturers' protection devices. It has great significance for configuring the protection system with different type and different number of protective devices according to the importance of the power system, improve the reliability level of the relay protection system and ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Research on collaborative regulation strategy of intelligent power equipment group
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the context of the electricity market reform, a coordination strategy of intelligent power equipment group based on load resource reservation is proposed. In order to meet the consumption needs of new energy sources such as wind power, some load resources are reserved when the load group is regulated. When there is a new energy consumption needs, call the reserved resources for new energy consumption, thereby enhancing the utilization of new energy. Under the mode of user's electricity reservation, the algorithm of load group joint optimal dispatching is proposed. Under the premise of guaranteeing normal power consumption, the algorithm achieves the goal of dissipating new energy and improving the load curve by scheduling and controlling a large number of same kinds of load. The simulation results showed that the algorithm can effectively consumed the new energy while guaranteeing the user's electricity consumption demand, and optimized the load curve at the same time.

articleTitle: Long-term wind power forecasting model by multi meteorological variables based on data compensation
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Long-term wind power forecasting plays an important role in the planning, prevention and control of harmful wind power events. However, short operation time of domestic wind farms result in the deficiencies of wind power data and it restricts the modeling of wind power forecasting. The staging operation of wind farms also bring bad effect to forecasting. To solve the problems, this paper proposed a long-term wind power forecasting model by multi meteorological variables based on data compensation. This model uses correlation coefficient method to select the optimal meteorological variables. Establishing the RBF neural network between optimal meteorological variables and historical power to get years of fitting power data. In this way, the power data can be compensated. Then, using the fitting power to replace the special year's wind power and forecasting the next year's wind power in steps of 3h. The verification with the actual data of Nanshan wind farm shows the proposed long-term forecasting method is effective and practicable. Those problems, deficiencies of power data and the special year, are solved.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy for PV inverter under unbalanced power grid
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To enhance the operation performance of the PV inverter under unbalanced grid voltage, this paper proposes a control strategy, which is based on negative sequence voltage feedforward, to make the grid-connected current of the inverter balanced and sinusoidal. Firstly, to separate the positive and negative sequence voltage quickly and accurately, the paper proposes a scheme based on the Second Order Generalized Integrator (SOGI) and the experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Secondly, to reject the negative sequence current component, a control strategy based on negative sequence voltage feedforward is designed in this paper. Finally, the proposed control strategy, which is validated effectively, is simulated and analyzed by PSCAD simulation software.

articleTitle: Dynamic performance research on bi-stable permanent magnetic actuator applied in 40.5kV vacuum circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to realize the safety and reliability operation of circuit breaker, the bi-stable permanent magnet actuator is presented according to the 40.5kV vacuum circuit breaker. In the aspect of theoretical analysis, the motion properties and load characteristics of transmission system are studied and given the principle, structure and design parameters of bi-stable permanent magnet actuator. The matching performance experimental system are designed and completed between the prototype and vacuum circuit breaker, which employed linear displacement sensor to measure the travel of contact. The opening and closing characteristics of contact are researched under the rated operational voltage, which analyzed the influence of different operating voltage and capacitance capacity for the opening and closing properties, the stability of motion characteristics for the bi-stable permanent magnet actuator under the same operating conditions through the matching experimental system. The testing results show that the average opening speed is 1.5m/s, average closing speed is 1.12m/s, which meet with the operating requirements of circuit breaker. The average opening speed increases 0.2m/s and average closing speed is 0.1m/s according with the operating voltage increases 20V. The average opening speed increases 0.15m/s and average closing speed is 0.1m/s according with the capacitance capacity increases 0.01F. The stability of operation time is high for the bi-stable permanent magnet actuator machine under the different operation times.

articleTitle: Nonlinear varying-network magnetic circuit analysis for segmental-rotor flux-switching motor
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A nonlinear varying-network magnetic circuit (VNMC) modeling method is presented for segmental-rotor flux-switching motor (SRFSM), which is substantially different from other flux-switching machines in magnet flux path. The method is used to analyze the static characteristics of SRFSM by specific permeance calculations and magnetic circuit equations, and the magnetic saturation is taken into account as well. Moreover, a novel permeance model of segmental rotor is presented to improve the calculation accuracy. The VNMC method provides an effective and efficient approach for calculating the static characteristics of SRFSM with different dimensions, parameters, and conditions. A SRFSM with 12/8-pole which may offer advantages in terms of torque density and unbalanced magnetic pull is used as an example. There is a good agreement between the results of the VNMC and the finite-element analysis (FEA).

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of power management techniques for a solar-powered embedded device
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Recently with the introduction of IoT (Internet-of Things), embedded devices are used in many ways. Supporting such devices requires cost-effective power supply and maintenance methods, because the number of devices in such environment easily becomes enormous. The use of solar power and rechargeable batteries among various energy-harvesting techniques for power supply to the embedded devices is an attractive approach because solar power is virtually abundant. However, we need to manage how to reserve and use the solar energy effectively because the power from the sun is available only during a certain period of time, and the amount harvested cannot be controlled. We present a simulator implemented to analyze the power management schemes for solar-powered embedded systems. Using the simulator, we compared how the power management techniques work with given environment. The results show that QoS based power management scheme can achieve higher performance than an online greedy method.

articleTitle: Prediction of dissolved gases in power transformer oil based on RBF-LSSVM regression and imperialist competition algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to accurately predict the dissolved gas content for the transformer oil in a period of time in the future, imperialist competitive algorithm (ICA) and the least squares support vector machine regression (LSSVR) were introduced to the prediction model. ICA is employed to optimize the hyper-parameters of constructed SVM regression, and the parameters of the radial basis function (RBF) kernel function are optimized and the prediction model is established. The results show that the proposed model has obvious advantages and the prediction effect is generally higher than BPNN, which verifies the correctness of the proposed method and the feasibility of the scheme. The MAPE in training of RBF - LSSVR less than 1.3% while BPNN's higher than 8.8%, at the same time, the MAPE in testing of RBF-LSSVR less than 1.8% while BPNN's higher than 9.0%.

Author Keywords: the least squares support vector machine

articleTitle: Experimental study on the tolerance ability of adjustable speed drives to voltage sags
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The process of energy transmitting is vulnerable to power quality problems. The adjustable speed drive (ASD) is one sensitive part of the process to voltage sags which will cause the interruption of the whole process if it trips due to sags. It is essential to analyze the voltage tolerance ability of ASDs and formulate a representative standard voltage tolerance curve (VTC) for it. Firstly, this paper analyzed basic influence principle of sags on ASDs and the influence of multiple factors on the voltage tolerance ability of ASDs, including sags types, load torque, motor speed, control strategy, pre-post sag voltage and harmonics. Then a test platform was established using the Chroma 61860 Regenerative Grid Simulator as the source of sag. 7 typical brands of ASDs with 2 kinds of rated power were selected to be tested. Later, sets of VTCs were obtained and further analyzed separately. The majority of the conclusions shows consistency to the theoretical analysis, but there are also some distinctions to the present conclusions. Finally, relatively universal VTCs for three of sags were proposed, which are of reference meaning to regulate the special standard curve for ASDs.

articleTitle: IEC61850 extensions to describe the configuration of feeder automation and metering systems
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To monitor and control the Medium Voltage (MV) distribution networks more efficiently, the Feeder Automation (FA) and metering systems require IEC61850 to improve the communication standardization and interoperability. This paper extends the System Configuration Language (SCL) of IEC61850 to describe MV networks, which is the vital basis for using IEC61580. New elements of `SubRegion' and `Line' are designed to indicate the primary topology of distribution feeders, where the function blocks and primary apparatus are combined. They are analyzed for the topology modelling of overhead, underground cable and the mixed style of MV feeders. Then, the configuration procedure is detailed based upon example applications to show the usage of SCL files for configuration of feeder automation and metering data of secondary substation systems.

articleTitle: Research on receptivity evaluation of distribution network based on optimal access of clean energy
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, with the quick developments of large-scale and decentralized clean energy power station, distribution network faces greater pressure of acceptance and absorption of clean energy power grid. This paper analyzed major constraints of distribution network on clean energy accepting, and obtained the relationship between clean energy output and abandoned electricity. An optimal access method based on the target of interconnected capacity maximization of clean energy power station, satisfying interval number, line capacity, substation capacity and investment constraints, was innovatively proposed in this paper, which can direct clean energy power station access effectively. Based on the optimal access method, this paper researched overall evaluation and key evaluation of distribution network acceptance ability, weak links were analyzed furtherly. Finally, realizing of accurate investment and access ability promotion were illustrated with case.

articleTitle: An integrated power restoration method based on improved genetic algorithm for active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing the permeability of distributed power supply in distribution network, the system reliability can be effectively improved by taking advantage of islanding operation capacity of DGs to restore non-fault area power supply when power failure occurs. This paper has made in-depth research on power restoration for active distribution network by taking distribution network power balance, the number of DG islands and communication switch influencing factors into consideration. By setting backup communication line equivalent to DG and referring it during decision-making process, the overall scheme superiority improves. The type and control characteristics of DGs are fully investigated in the process of using DG to restore load power. This paper also researched the recovery scheme of island power supply in master-slave control mode by separating DGs into master-slave power source. The concept of two chromosome coding constraints and genome / gene sub block are proposed by adopting improved genetic algorithm to get solution and combining active distribution network structure and master-slave control mode when separating islands. It helps to realize avoiding invalid solutions as the cross and mutation operations between chromosomes are completely based on genome. Finally, simulation has been made to verify the validity of the method proposed with 3 feeder lines and 7 DGs.

articleTitle: Novel control strategy and modeling of air source heat pump for consuming PV power
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The rapid development of PV power generation has led to numerous problems of system operation and PV power consumption. As a new type of heat pump, the air source heat pump has advantages of energy saving, environment protection and good flexibility. In this paper, PV generation power during generation peak time is consumed by air source heat pumps to produce and storage heat. First, this paper establishes a basic thermophysical model of air source heat pump and analyzes the method of using air source heat pumps to consume PV generation power. Second, a control strategy for consuming PV generation power by clustering air source heat pumps with different parameters is proposed. Then, a multi-objective scheduling model of air source heat pumps is presented. Finally, NSGA-II is used to solve the multi-objective model, and the corresponding Pareto optimal solutions are obtained. The simulation results show that the model proposed in this paper can well follow the PV generation output, reduce the PV power curtailment and heating cost of users.

articleTitle: Control strategy of photovoltaic generation inverter grid-connected operating and harmonic elimination hybrid system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a three-phase three-wire photovoltaic generation inverter grid-connected operating and harmonic elimination hybrid system. The hybrid system mainly consists of photovoltaic array battery, photovoltaic output filter, three-phase voltage-type inverter, inverter output filter and passive filters. Based on working principle and working characteristics of the proposed hybrid system, the composite control strategy about active power, reactive power and harmonic suppression is proposed. The composite control strategy mainly consists of a single closed-loop control slip of active power and reactive power, double closed-loop control slip of harmonics. Simulation results show the correctly of this paper's contents, the hybrid system have an effective to improve power factor, supply active power for loads and suppress harmonics of micro-grid.

articleTitle: The simulation analyses of Jinnan ± 800kV UHVDC transmission control system based on PSCAD/EMTDC
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Taking Jinnan ± 800kV ultra-high voltage direct current power transmission system as study object, this paper discusses simulation model of UHVDC by PSCAD /EMTDC (Power system computer aided design and electric magnetic transient in DC system). Compared with the waveform in actual engineering system debugging, the results of a series of simulation analyses show that the ± 800kV UHVDC system constructed is reliable. The simulation platform can deeply study the control system of UHVDC, which has the practical significance of engineering.

Author Keywords: ultra-high voltage direct current power transmission system

articleTitle: Research on meteorological impact factors of wind farm output power in plateau mountainous areas
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: It is discussed the characteristics of wind resource, and is forced on researching the meteorological impact factors of wind farm output power in plateau mountain areas and in different terrain conditions. The thesis analyzes the influences of wind farm output power caused by meteorological impact factors in wind farm areas with the typical characteristics of plateau mountain areas. Finally, It is pointed out that the set of wind speed and wind direction is the minimum meteorological impact factor set of wind farm output power in plateau mountain areas.

articleTitle: Imapct of VAr compensation on total harmonic distortion measured using smart meter
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The widespread use of non-linear loads means the traditional meters fail to give accurate values of real power, reactive power and apparent power in the presence of high levels of distortion factors. This inevitably creates big difference between the actual and calculated/measured savings resulting from reactive power compensation. It has been investigated the impact of distortion factors on the determination of savings accrued from VAr compensation using both traditional and smart meters. Results in the paper clearly demonstrate the effect of VAR compensation on total harmonic distortion measured with smart meter.

articleTitle: Loss analysis of contactless power transmission in seawater
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper describes about power loss of Contactless Power Transmission (CPT) in seawater. Power transmission experiment was done in saline water, deionized water and air. The antennas are placed in the fish tank which is filled by liquid. Experimental results show that transmission efficiency in saline water is approximately 5% lower than that of in air. In saline water, loss that is caused by salinity of water appear on transmission loss. This loss is caused by the complex dielectric constant and the conductivity of saline water.

articleTitle: A compound control method for optimal configuration of wind/PV/storage system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the renewable energy system, aiming at the instability and strong randomness of wind and solar energy output power, a compound control method based on the energy storage ratio and the power smoothing parameters is proposed. The method can control the fluctuation amplitude within the set value by charging, discharging or running off the system. By simulating the two configurations of single and double energy storage, the compound control algorithm is used to carry out the simulation experiment, and the power smoothing effect, economic benefit and other comprehensive indexes are compared. The simulation results show that the system has better running effect under single energy storage.

articleTitle: Fault analysis and fast protection of DC bus in MMC-based HVDC grids
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: DC bus protection is a key technological problem to be solved in MMC-based HVDC grids. This article mainly deals with fast DC bus protection based on transient characteristic analysis of faults at different location. By building the equivalent grid model, transient fault characteristics of internal and external pole-to-pole faults can be obtained, the difference of which mainly shows in voltage derivative and current change. Then the protection criterions can be set using these two parameters. Finally, simulations in PSCAD/EMTDC verify the effectiveness and sensitivity of proposed protection method.

articleTitle: Harmonic assessments with multi-values considering the regulation effect
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The current method of harmonic evaluation is comparing the 95% value with the limit value based on GB/T 14549-93<;Quality of electric energy supply harmonics in public supply network>, which can only judge whether the harmonic is exceeded or not. But it cannot evaluate the degree of harmonic pollution. Under the premise of ensuring the power quality of the utility grid as well as taking the different harmonic characteristics of the harmonic source users into account, it is necessary to refine the excessive degree of harmonics out of specification. And, the harmonics evaluation should link harmonic current assessment to harmonic voltage evaluation effectively to get a better assessment result. And a method of using multi-values maybe can be adopted. Therefore, a method of harmonic assessment with multi-values considering the regulation effect is proposed in this paper. The proposed method divides the harmonics influence on power grid into seven grades, which can give the reference to the harmonic mitigation both considering the cost of harmonic governance and the effect of the harmonic mitigation. The result of the case study proves the proposed method is effective and feasible to the harmonic assessment.

articleTitle: Study on the output fluctuation of intermittent energy source based on NASA data
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The proposing of Global Energy Internet provides a golden opportunity for the worldwide development of intermittent energy source. Considering the current situation of lacking time-varying data of intermittent energy source, this paper studies the output fluctuation of intermittent energy source in Northwest China based on the data from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC). The paper firstly extracts wind speed and surface net downward shortwave flux of 10 years as initial data and converts the data into generation output using specific device parameters. Then a statistical analysis is made about the regional, annual, seasonal, and day-night output of the wind and photovoltaic power. It has calculated the best capacity configuration by combining wind and solar energy to describe the complementary degree. The results suggest that annual difference between wind and PV power output is slight, while the regional, seasonal, and day-night differences are obvious, and the outputs of wind and PV are complementary. These results provide the basis to determine reserve capacity considering grid integration of renewable energy generation. These data provide decision support for the construction of wind and photovoltaic farms.

articleTitle: Research on modeling spatiotemporal correlation of wind power forecast error on multiple wind farms based on Copula theory
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The forecast errors of multiple geographically close wind farms have spatiotemporal dependence and this correlation has significant impact to the operation of power system. Therewith, this paper proposes a method to model spatiotemporal correlation of wind power forecast error for multiple wind farms based on Copula theory. Firstly, by comparing fitting accuracy of different fitting methods, KDE-based method with highest fitting accuracy is chose to fit marginal distribution of forecast error. Then, this paper proposes a high dimensional modeling method for short-term wind power forecast error using Copula function and obtains joint cumulative distribution function (JCDF) of forecast errors for multiple wind farms. Finally, the actual forecast error data of four wind farms is used to verily the model. Comparing with the actual dependence structure, the method based on Copula function can effectively model the spatiotemporal correlation and detect independence of wind power forecast errors. Thus the effectiveness of proposed method is proved by simulated results.

articleTitle: A coordinated protection scheme for DC faults in multi-terminal MMC-HVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: When a pole-to-pole dc fault occurs, it is desirable that the stations continue contributing to power transfer, rather than blocking. Thus, the current limiting module is connected in series with each arm branch to reduce the large current before the faulty lines are totally isolated by DC circuit breakers. The pole-to-pole fault requires fast identification to trigger the current limiting module. Additionally, the pole-to-ground dc fault with high resistance is another concern. Based on the significant voltage drop on the boundary device of inductance caused by the current surge on the faulty pole, the voltage fault components of both positive pole and negative pole are utilized to conduct a novel protection scheme. The coordinated protection scheme for DC line faults in multi-terminal MMC-HVDC transmission system is presented and simulations based on PSCAD/EMTDC software confirm its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Coupling characteristics and mechanism of the dynamic behaviors of high and low voltage power grid
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The increasing complexity of the dynamic behavior of low-voltage (LV) power grid makes it necessary for synchronous phasor measurement in LV grids. After a large disturbance, the dynamic behavior detected at the LV level is the coupling between dynamic behaviors of high-voltage (HV) major grid and LV local grid, which needs to be decoupled for different applications. This paper analyzes the response characteristics of LV power grid to a variety of common disturbances and proposes a mathematical model for the synchronized measurement data of high and low voltage grids. The coupling phenomenon of dynamic behaviors is explained for different load models. Finally, the theoretical analysis is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Least mean absolute third adaptive control algorithm for distribution static compensator
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: It is well known that the functions of DSTATCOM are reactive power compensation, harmonics elimination and load balancing under linear and nonlinear loads. To obtain the corresponding active and reactive weights and supply reference currents, this paper presents an implementation of distribution static compensator (DSTATCOM) using least mean absolute third based adaptive algorithm (LMAT) for the three-phase distribution system. The performance of proposed control algorithm is observed under nonlinear load in simulation and the proposed algorithm is fast in convergence and has quick response. The DSTATCOM using LMAT algorithm is effective in alleviating various power-quality problems and the test results of Simulink are found satisfactory with harmonic distortion of the supply currents meeting the power quality standards.

Author Keywords: least mean absolute third (LMAT) based algorithm

articleTitle: Analysis of subsynchronous oscillation characteristics and its dominant factors in the DFIG-based wind farm with fixed series compensation
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at subsynchronous oscillation (SSO) in doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind farm with fixed series compensation (FSC), this paper analyze its characteristics based on eigenvalue analysis. Analysis results indicate that this kind of SSO is the electrical interaction related to the generator, converter and FSC, and its basic characteristics are similar with induction generator effect (IGE). The root causes include negative resistors effect related to the rotor resistor and current inner loop of rotor side converter (RSC) in subsynchronous frequency range, and subsynchronous modulation effect of the converters.

articleTitle: An improved islanding detection method based on adaptive chopper factor for inverter-interfaced distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Islanding detection is of great importance for normal operation of distributed generation system. In this paper, Active Frequency Drift (AFD) method is chosen to illustrate its operation principle and concrete performance procedure in detail. On this basis, an improved method based on adaptive chopper factor is proposed to reduce the impact of the load property on AFD. The improved method can automatically change chopper factor according to different load properties to eliminate non-detected zone (NDZ)and accelerate islanding detection. Detailed analysis is included in this paper, finally simulations are carried out in Matlab to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Risk warning of important power user based on electricity load characteristic
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grid, the power supply security demand becomes higher. Important power user is the main pillar of social and economic development. It's power outage may cause person casualties, larger environment pollution, greater political influence and large economic loss. How to ensure the effective warning, analysis, diagnosis and treatment of safety power supply to important users become a new research subject. Electricity load directly reflect the power user's real time electricity consumption and its power risk is often accompanied by the occurrence of power safety accidents. The paper firstly analyzes the power load characteristic and mode, determine the risk index and threshold of power load, then on the basis, build security risk warning model and propose early warning method based on SMF-DFA, finally carry out the practical verification. The research result has important theoretical and practical significance to power risk management and power gird safe.

articleTitle: Degradation state recognition of ultrasonic motor based upon locality preserving projection and support vector machine optimized by fruit fly optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The cracking of piezoelectric ceramic components is one of the main failure pattern of ultrasonic motors. The degradation characteristics can be extracted effectively by monitoring the voltage signal of piezoelectric sensor. High dimensional feature vector contains a lot of redundant information due to dimension disaster. Locality preserving projection (LPP) can effectively reduce dimension on the degradation feature, which can fuse the high dimension feature. The parameters of support vector machine (SVM) have an important influence on the generalization ability of the model. Fruit fly optimization algorithm (FOA) has the advantages of few parameters, fast calculation speed, strong ability of global optimization and easy to implement. FOA is utilized to optimize SVM in this paper accordingly, and the optimized SVM by FOA (FOASvM) is applied in degradation state recognition of ultrasonic motor. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through the comparative analysis.

Author Keywords: the voltage signal of piezoelectric sensor

articleTitle: Study on the influence of amorphous debris on the magnetic field distribution of amorphous alloy transformer
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Since the concept of sustainable development and energy-saving emission reduction enjoying popular support, energy-saving amorphous alloy transformer is widely promoted, and the problem of oil-immersed amorphous debris is further highlighted. This paper simulated the magnetic field of the oil-immersed amorphous alloy transformer containing amorphous debris to determine the effect of the amorphous debris on the performance of magnetic field. This paper draws the conclusions that the magnetic field intensity internal the amorphous debris is almost zero but not equal to zero, the magnetic induction intensity inside the amorphous alloy core debris being much larger than that inside the dielectric oil and the maximum value can be increased by 7 times.

articleTitle: A summary of research on converged communication model of power network and information network
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper presented a summary of the recent progress of the integration of communication and information network. Power grid can carry power supply and demand interaction must be in the interaction between the two sides to form a two-way data flow ring Based on the standard CPS modeling theory the architecture of supply and demand interaction and the core node function based on information physical fusion are designed. The CPS interactive platform can give full play to the advantages of distributed intelligent unit can adapt to multi-level control and optimization needs can effectively support the future of power supply and demand interactive business flexibility.

articleTitle: Analysis of the correlation between characteristic of equivalent load and power loss in smart distribution grid
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: There are many kinds of characteristics of smart distribution grid, such as the complex structure, the complexity of the users, and the factors that affect the power grid loss, which not only related to the spatial distribution of the load, but also the load on the time scale of the power changes. Aiming at the relationship between the load and the network loss in the smart distribution grid, the relationship between the load and the network loss is taken into consideration, and the deep intrinsic relationship between the load and the loss is extracted and the corresponding temporal and spatial characteristic parameters are presented. Based on the spatial parameters and time parameters of the relationship between the equivalent load and the network loss, a time-space characteristic analysis model of equivalent load is established. Based on the data of a regional distribution network in Jiangsu Province, the correlation between the equivalent load and the network loss is analyzed, and its feasibility is verified. And to analyze its correlation to explore the deep link between load and loss.

articleTitle: Damped PR controller based modeling and simulation of single phase grid connected photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Solar energy is the most prominently used source of renewable energy. Over the years, grid connected configuration have gained significant growth in solar energy systems. In present study a 5 kW dual stage grid connected photovoltaic (PV) system was modeled and simulated using PSCAD/EMTDC software. Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithm was implemented to extract maximum power from PV system irrespective of the environmental conditions. A control strategy to regulate the quality of grid injected current using damped Proportional Resonant (PR) controller was also implemented. The result showed that the total harmonic distortion (THD) of the grid injected current obtained within the standard range and its more feasible values were achieved. Firstly, the robust system response at step change in solar irradiations was observed, afterwards power sharing between grid and PV system was demonstrated by the simulation under varying load and irradiation levels.

articleTitle: Research on micro-grid distribution network and its operation efficiency in the energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Energy Internet strategy is the penetration of the idea in the global, national, city, area within the different level scopes. As the basis of the energy module, micro energy network is the micro level component of the urban energy Internet. This paper puts forward a new idea of the development of micro-grid distribution network, and makes a comparative analysis of the effectiveness of the commercial operation in the context of the energy Internet. On this basis, proposed under different operating modes of micro grid of the cost-benefit model of distribution network operators, and the effectiveness of this method was verified with the real case considering of building the main, operation mode, tax policy and other factors of the comprehensive.

articleTitle: Low DC voltage control strategy of bipolar LCC-MMC hybrid HVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper investigates a bipolar hybrid high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system, the rectifier adopts line commutated converter (LCC) and the inverter adopts hybrid modular multilevel converter (MMC). The hybrid HVDC transmission system not only combines the advantages of LCC and MMC, but also has a strong capability to deal with AC or DC faults. This paper mainly studies the control strategy of the bipolar LCC-MMC hybrid HVDC transmission system when running at low DC voltage. For the traditional symmetric hybrid MMC, an improved control strategy is proposed to balance the voltages of the two seed modules, which significantly expands the operating DC voltage range of the system. Moreover, the topological structure of bipolar asymmetric hybrid MMC is designed and the control strategy when running at low DC voltage is presented. It is found that the DC voltage of the bipolar asymmetric hybrid MMC remains symmetric and can be adjusted freely. At last, the simulations based on PSCAD/EMTDC show the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Study on characteristics of wind power generation in plateau mountainous area
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As a new type of clean energy, wind energy has been developing rapidly in recent years. In plateau mountains, the characteristics of the wind decide that it is different from that in plains and offshore wind power generation. The research shows that the actual output power of the wind turbine is different from the theoretical under the same wind speed and blade area because of the low air density in plateau mountainous. The winter is prone to freezing disaster such as blade icing which will impact power generation and even damage the unit; The lightning disaster may damage the control system of wind turbines or blade or cause other accidents. All of these must be considered in the power prediction of wind farms, unit design, selection and opearation.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization of capacity configuration for grid-connected microgrid system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The grid-connected microgrid can be connected to the distribution network, which can provide some power support from the distribution network, and can run independently when the distribution network is faulty. This paper first analyzes the comprehensive benefits of grid-connected microgrid, then considers the coordinated operation of distributed power supply, peak and valley price and spare capacity when interacting with distribution network. Finally, a multi-objective optimal allocation model including the economic, environmental and reliability benefits of microgrid is proposed, and the multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of magnetic coupling resonant wireless power transfer system with Class-E inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Magnetic coupling resonant Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) System is widely used in the medium distance field as a novel technology. This paper presents a WPT system with a proper Class-E inverter structure. In order to solve the problem of the frequency splitting in WPT system. A method is proposed in the system to trace the emission frequency and the receive frequency and control the frequency. Finally, the simulation and experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed control algorithms. In the end, simulation experimental results are shown to confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Hourly solar radiation forecasting using LS-based volterra filters
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, a new solar radiation (insolation) prediction method is proposed that uses the Volterra filter which is trained based on the least squares (LS) criterion. Only historical insolation data are used as input information to train the Volterra filter that consists of the first- and second-order kernels. The proposed method is applied to real datasets of hourly insolation data of four years (2012-2015), which were downloaded from the website of Japan Meteorological Agency. Extensive simulations demonstrate the forecasting superiority of the proposed method over the naive persistence model (NPM), the autoregressive (AR) model, and the feedforward neural network (FFNN) schemes. Furthermore, the proposed method requires much lower training cost as compared to the FFNNs.

articleTitle: Research on effects of large-scale wind farms integration on bus protection
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Different from synchronous machines integration system, the short current of DFIG integration system contains lots of aperiodic components caused by non-fault branch when a bus external fault occurs. That makes the linear transfer area of CT saturated secondary current reduced or even lost, thus increasing the number of sampling points which meet the latch to open criterion. It will affect the accuracy of blocking component's action. The PSCAD/EMTDC simulation results also show that wind farm integration indeed has a negative impact on action of bus blocking component.

articleTitle: Hierarchical control strategies for islanded microgrids based on modular multilevel converters (MMCs)
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper presents a hierarchical control strategy (HCS) for modular multilevel converter (MMC)-based islanded microgrid which is composed of two parts: the inner MMC control (IMC) and the outer loop control (OLC). The former includes the voltage and current control loops and the circulating current suppression algorithm, which are used to stabilize the bridge arm voltage, balance the individual capacitor voltage and suppress the circulating current. The later includes the droop control, secondary control and voltage/current harmonic regulation control loops, which are used to obtain good power sharing, balance the main circuit voltage, restore the frequency deviations and suppress the output voltage harmonics. Then, the dynamic linear/nonlinear load perturbation and single-phase load transient disturbance are applied to test the effectiveness of the proposed control strategies. The simulation results obtained from Matlab/Simulink are presented to verify the strategy.

articleTitle: Research on pressure fluctuation in impeller and guide vane of boiler water circulating pump
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The boiler water circulating pump is the core component of the supercritical power station starting system. The circulating media in the pump is high temperature and high pressure water, so the reliability of the boiler water circulation pump is very important. Because the pressure fluctuation may cause resonance eccentric operation of the unit and even the destruction of the static and dynamic components, pressure fluctuation analysis of boiler circulating pump is helpful to improve the stability of unit operation. In this paper, the pressure fluctuation of impeller and guide vane in boiler water circulating pump was calculated and analyzed by software ANSYS-CFX. The results showed that: with the increase of the flow rate, the periodicity of pressure fluctuations at monitoring points in the impeller and the guide vane becomes more and more obvious, and the fluctuation amplitude decreases gradually. The pressure fluctuations of the monitoring points in the impeller are mainly affected by the leaf frequency of the guide vane which is 536.36Hz. The first three monitoring points in the guide vane are mainly affected by the leaf frequency of impeller which is 292.56Hz. There is no significant fluctuation at the monitoring point DY04.

articleTitle: Automatic fault line selection technology for small current grounding system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The low voltage distribution network in our country widely adopts non-direct grounding system, called as small current grounding system. Single-phase ground fault is the most common occurrence for this system. Now, some power supply departments in our country still recognize fault lines by traditional artificial method, meaning low efficiency and accuracy. To improve the efficiency and reliability of fault line selection for small current grounding distribution network, fast and accurate automatic fault line selection method has always been an important research topic in power system. This paper analyzes current researches of automatic fault line selection methods for small current grounding distribution network, and comprehensively compares the current methods. Besides, based on travelling rule researches of fault travelling wave, a fault line detection approach based on travelling wave natural frequency and amplitude information is put forward in this paper, providing useful reference for scholars.

articleTitle: Propagation feature of partial discharge UHF signal diffusing from GIS pouring aperture
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: It is a novel method to detect partial discharge of GIS by detecting the UHF electromagnetic wave signal diffusing from the pouring aperture in the insulator containing iron hoop. In contrast with the feature of UHF electromagnetic diffusing from the bare insulator without iron hoop, UHF electromagnetic wave diffusing from pouring aperture is undiscovered due to the tiny dimension and special configuration. In this paper, propagation feature of the UHF electromagnetic wave through the pouring aperture was analyzed by using the theory of pore electromagnetic leakage and it is simulated based on the finite difference time domain method. The conclusion is that the orientation of electric field principal component of UHF signal from the aperture is parallel to the short edge of aperture. The primary frequency range is concentrated from 0.8 to 2GHz. In addition, rangeability of the signal caused by the change of the long edge is much higher than the rangeability of the signal caused by the change of short edge.

articleTitle: Data assimilation method based on wind farm data and DBSCAN-OI algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Numerical weather prediction (NWP) provides essential information for renewable energy power forecasting. In order to improve the accuracy of NWP, this paper presents an optimized data assimilation method based on DBSCAN-OI algorithm. Based on DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise), the multi-scale grid is established. Then, OI (Optimal interpolation) algorithm is used to obtain data assimilation results for each grid. This method makes full use of wind observational data of electric-power industry and provides a new data assimilation algorithm for electric-power industry. Case study shows that this method is able to improve the accuracy of mesoscale and microscale numerical weather prediction.

articleTitle: Characteristic research of commutation failure for hybrid AC/DC system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Commutation failure is a kind of common failure type for Ultra High Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) system, and its influence on hybrid AC/DC system are widely studied by researchers. Based on the detailed hybrid AC/DC system model, established in electromagnetic transient simulation software PSCAD/EMTDC, dynamic characteristics of the hybrid system under commutation failure, and key influence factors for commutation failure degree, are researched in this paper. In the model, UHVDC is connected to the AC system through double circuit transmission lines. Research results show that, the established hybrid AC/DC system model in this paper can reflect electromagnetic properties of different operation conditions, especially for commutation failure condition, and strength of AC system, fault type, fault resistance and other factors will have an apparent impact on commutation failure degree, laying solid foundations for subsequent protection related issues in hybrid AC/DC system.

articleTitle: The rapid development of a three-phase grid-forming micro-source inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper takes the rapid development of a three-phase grid-forming micro-source inverter as the research purpose. Sliding mode control (SMC) and PI control strategies are adopted synthetically to implement the dual closed-loop controller. Firstly, Simulink model is built according to the actual inverter development condition. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. And then, the control codes are generated automatically based on the model design method. With the generated controller codes, it realizes the rapid development of a proposed GFI inverter. The hardware experiments are presented in the paper to demonstrate that the developed grid-forming micro-source inverter performs good robustness property under different load conditions and parameter uncertainty scenario.

articleTitle: Comparative performance evaluation of PLLs based on filtering techniques for grid-integration of renewable energy systems
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The phase-locked loops (PLLs) is very important for synchronization between the utility networks and the three-phase grid-interfaced renewable energy converters. To improve the performance of PLLs under the distorted grid conditions, incorporating different filtering techniques into the PLL has been proposed in many literature. The main aim of this paper is to present a survey of the comparative performance evaluation among the PLLs based on different filtering techniques (include DSC-PLL, PMAF-PLL, AMAF-PLL, DMAF-PLL, HPLL, LPF-PLL, TPSF-PLL and CCF-PLL). The dynamic performance of these PLLs under various grid voltage disturbance scenarios, such as grid voltage sag, voltage flicker, phase and frequency jump, harmonics, noise and DC offset is presented through experimental test. And a useful insight about the advantages and disadvantages of these PLLs has been concluded in this paper.

articleTitle: Simulation and fault analysis of DC breaker in HVDC converter station
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The metallic return transfer breaker (MRTB) is a key apparatus to break the DC current in 500 kV HVDC converter stations. It is usually used for monopole-ground operation mode/ bipolar operation model transferring. In this paper, an actual occurred fault of 500 kV HVDC breaker in HVDC converter station is presented in details. In order to analyze the complicated transient performance, a simulation with Mayr arc model is carried out in Matlab. The transient oscillation process of arc current, charging process after the arc, and the discharging process with current flowing through the arrester are analyzed, along with the on-site measurement current and field test of loop RLC parameter for verification and analysis. Finally, the actual failure processes of the proposed MRTB are analyzed in detail, which might be of some help for manufacture of 500 kV MRTB DC breaker in parameter design and give some suggestions to power company in grid operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Research on optimization of power grid voltage class series based on rapid load growth
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper investigate the present situation and history of voltage class series of major city power grids at home and abroad. The technical and economic characteristic of 35 kV and 110 kV is analyzed. The advantage of 110 kV is demonstrated. With the increase of load density, the power supply capacity of 500/220/110/10kV is obviously improved, and the advantages of economy are more prominent. For areas with 35kV power supply, the development and transition of 110kV should be considered as the load density increases.

articleTitle: Wind field reconstruction using non-negative matrix factorization and principal component analysis with CFD basis
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: For the purpose of selecting the best sites for installation of wind farms and for increasing the net yield of wind energy, the wind speed is required to be determined at different positions, within a domain of interest. This helps to determine the natural variance/uncertainty in the wind speed, which is very useful for predicting the wind power potential in an area. For this, a huge amount of data is required to be processed (from wind speed sensor measurements) and mathematical algorithms are required for rapid reconstruction of the wind field. The Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) have been presented, which can be applied for reconstructing the wind field around obstruction models using CFD basis. The absolute reconstruction error tends to increase with an increase in the inlet velocity. The relative accuracy of NMF and PCA are subject to the sampling rate of the measurement, but there is no influence on the distribution of the wind speed sensors around the obstructions model (above a sampling rate of 0.05%). By application of these reconstruction models using WSR, it has been concluded that the NMF and PCA can be adequately used to reconstruct the wind field around an obstruction model.

articleTitle: Research on weakness identification of regional power grid and flexible power supply allocation requirements
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, the Characteristics of convenient installation and low carbon caused renewable energy sources researches such as wind power and solar energy becoming a key field of power system development. However, affected by the natural environment factors, the Wind power and photovoltaic power generation are intermittent and random, and the large scale of Wind power and photovoltaic power generation parallel in will make a great risk to power system operation. In this paper, the regional power system operation is Studied connected with intermittent power generation, the indicators of Reserve at risk, Energy not supply at risk conditional reserve at risk and Conditional Energy Not Supply at Risk are presented. the Evaluation of the fluctuation range of regional power grid accommodating new energy output is put forward. Considering the uncertainty of new energy output and load, the regional power grid flexibility index are established. After identifying the weak areas of power system with large scale wind power and photovoltaic power generation parallel in, the capacity and distribution requirements of Large scale wind and photovoltaic power connection to flexibly adjust power is proposed. At last, the model is verified effective.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation of equipment utilization on DG-connected distribution network based on pignistic probability distance optimum evidence synthesis
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Large-scale distributed generation (DG) accessing to the distribution network (DN), will affect the distribution network equipment utilization rate (DNEUR). However, at present, there is a lack of comprehensive research on the effect of DG connected to grid on the comprehensive evaluation of DNEUR. Hence, this paper constructs a comprehensive evaluation system of DNEUR, according to the characteristics of DG power generation and the influence of DG connected to grid on the DNEUR. Comprehensive evaluation system includes six aspects: power supply reliability, safety criterion, grid structure, load characteristics, grid construction margin and equipment load capacity. In order to overcome the limitations of Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and entropy weight method, a new AHP-entropy weight combination weighting method based on Pignistic probability distance optimal evidence synthesis is proposed. And on this basis, a comprehensive evaluation model is constructed. Finally, the operation data of five typical regions are used to verify the model. The results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the influence of deviation from the expert weight. In the process of AHP-entropy weighting, the weight of the subjective and objective weights is adjusted scientifically according to the optimization results.

articleTitle: Research on flow noise in water-cooled motor room of pump
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Damping and noise-reducing have become a popular topic nowadays. Two of the main noise source of Pump unit are from the pump and the motor. People have done a great deal of work in the two aspects for reducing the noise of pumps and air cooling motors. According to the related research, the noise which is generated by air-cooling motor is much higher than that in water-cooled motor. If the air-cooled motor in the pump unit is changed into a water-cooled motor, the noise level of the unit would be greatly reduced. Based on the theory about resistance muffler of the multiple chamber, the authors design a reactive muffling chamber for water cooling motor and the simulation results prove it has a great advantages in middle-high frequency band.

articleTitle: Fundamental frequency switching strategy of 120-unit cascaded half-bridge multilevel converter for battery management system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper presents a fundamental frequency switching strategy for single phase modular multilevel converter that consists of 120 cascaded battery-based half-bridge units, aiming to generate voltage with low harmonics. The strategy is based on the calculation of the Delay-Time for each unit, after which the half-bridge switches to change the state (connected or disconnected) of the corresponding battery. In this manner, the number of battery cells connected in the circuit is varied and a staircase shape voltage is synthesized. Moreover, the internal resistance of battery can cause the terminal voltage deviation and lead to inaccurate calculation of Delay-Time, which will introduce more harmonics. An improved method is developed to compensate the battery voltage drop. State-space representation is used to describe the circuit and battery model. Simulation is conducted to verify the modulation technique.

articleTitle: Centralized residential load scheduling with consideration of voltage control in future distribution system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, rooftop photovoltaic (PV) power generation, electric vehicle (EV) are developing quickly worldwide. However, high degree of PV penetration in residential area will cause overvoltage problem. A large number of EVs charging at the same time will cause low voltage problem. This research aims to introduce load scheduling method for voltage control in the distribution system. A day-ahead load scheduling and a real-time load rescheduling are proposed. The day-ahead scheduling is formulated as an optimization problem and solved by genetic algorithm (GA). In the real-time operation, a coordinated real-time voltage control of an on-line tap changer (OLTC) and community energy management system (CEMS) is proposed. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated in an 1800-customer distribution system model.

articleTitle: A novel direct distribution method based on dynamic characteristic coefficient for combined heat and power dispatch in single extraction units
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The combined heat and power (CHP) dispatch is of important to determine the optimal combination of the power and heat outputs, satisfying heat and power demand and operational constraints. This paper aims to propose a novel direct distribution method based on dynamic characteristic coefficient in single extraction units. More precisely, some dynamic characteristic equations are first established according to cycle function method; then, the optimization problem of CHP dispatch is formulated. To perform well, linear programming is implemented by comparing with our method. Experimental results suggest that our method has appropriate accuracy with sufficient benefits in guiding the operation for load dispatch in practice.

articleTitle: Loss calculation of smart distribution grid based on the similarity of feeder loss
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, with the fast development of various new power supply, the composition of smart distribution grid is increasingly diverse. Thus, the difficulty of network loss calculation is increased. Based on the influence of time - space characteristics of load on distribution network loss, the basic parameters of distribution network structure and load is considered, and the Kmeans clustering algorithm is used to classify the feeder. Based on the obtained data of the feeder network loss, the network loss of other feeders is estimated according to the similarity of the feeder load parameters, and then the whole network loss of the distribution network is calculated. Based on the case of Jiangsu power grid, based on the similarity of feeder loss is analyzed, and its feasibility is verified. The Jiangsu power grid is taken as an example for the calculation of smart distribution grid loss based on the similarity of feeder loss, and the feasibility of the method is verified.

articleTitle: New experimental method for H-bridge modules used in the distributed new energy field based on voltage-current dual control
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: H-bridge module is widely used in the distributed new energy field such as windfarm, photovoltaic, STATCOM, etc. The module must be experimented under full-power, but the traditional experimental method is not efficient because the module must be tested one by one. In this paper, through a full DC power supply charging power and energy supply to build a new type of test platform, can effectively reduce the access to the power grid requirements. The transfer function is deduced by the voltage-current dual control scheme, and the PID controller and its parameters are designed according to the Bode diagram. The effectiveness of the scheme is verified by simulink simulation and industrial test. It provides a new method for solving the full power test of high voltage and high capacity of H-bridge in the new energy filed.

articleTitle: Fault detection of photovoltaic arrays based on support vector data description
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A photovoltaic (PV) power plant consists of a large number of photovoltaic arrays (PVAs). PVA fault detection is essential to reliable PV plant operation. This paper presents an accurate and cost-efficient PVA fault detection method. The proposed method uses Support Vector Data Description (SVDD) technique. Therefore, ground truth labeling is not required. In addition, it performs fault detection solely based on the data collected by existing SCADA system, without requiring additional data sensing hardware installation. Experimental study on a real-world PV plant demonstrates that the proposed method achieves over 92% average precision on PVA fault detection.

articleTitle: Research on calling sequence of peaking regulation means in power system with pumped hydro power (PHP) station
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, the pumped storage power station and other conventional power sources will be considered to participate in the peaking regulation of power system, and the adjustment order to obey has been studied. Based on the key concepts including continuous ramping events and unit capacity adjustment cost, an comprehensive cost optimization model for the adjustment order of different peaking-regulation measures is proposed, in which the characteristics of the system load ramping, pumped storage power station characteristics, all kinds of peak adjustment means cost have been taken into consideration. The example has shown that the method can effectively realize the sorting of many kinds of peaking regulation measures in the power system. It also has shown that the calling order of the pumped storage power station not always takes the first place as the conventional consideration, which is necessary to combine with the specific conditions of the system.

articleTitle: Dynamic characteristics of a novel bistable electromagnetic vibration energy harvester excited by gauss white noise
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, the energy harvester is becoming more and more diversified, its aim is to increase the output power, the model of bistable electromagnetic vibration energy harvester with an auxiliary nonlinear oscillator through combining the mass-spring-damper system and a conventional bistable electromagnetic vibration energy harvester is first proposed, the bistable, nonlinear and two degrees of freedom of the system are simultaneously achieved, and the dimensionless governing equations of the system are established. Building white noise excitation signal, the effects of noise intensity, mass ratio and frequency ratio to the dynamic behavior and root mean square power of the system are studied respectively by matlab numerical simulation, the influences of these changing parameters are obtained. The research results can provide a theoretical basis for the related researches of bistable electromagnetic vibration energy harvester system.

articleTitle: A new type of full scale photovoltaic DC power generation system and its control strategy of modular multilevel converter
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This new full scale photovoltaic DC power generation system was proposed to improve the efficiency of the new energy power system. The system consists of two parts: the series DC-DC converter part which realizes the maximum power output of the PV system and the establishment of the high voltage DC bus, and the MMC which realizes the high voltage and high power inverter. In this paper, we paid close attention on the operation principle of modular multilevel converter. Much work had been done to establish the switching state space model based on MMC and AC small-signal model. We put forward a dual-loop three-phase access strategy to grid based on carrier phase-shifted sinusoidal pulse width modulation technique to realize the significant degradation decoupling of modular multilevel converter model, in which MMC outer loop is subjected to the voltage while inner loop is subjected to the current. In this paper, an MMC simulation system with 4kV direct current bus and 5 level voltage is modeled to test the feasibility. And the stability and rapid response of the simulation model is outstanding.

articleTitle: Research on the strategy of voltage sag comprehensive management based on supply and demand coordination
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a comprehensive strategy based on the coordination of users and power system to make up for the lack of coordination between power supply and demand. To the grid, in order to accurately identify the weak area of the grid, line selection model bases on net present value (NPV) method is established. To the users, transformation revenue quantification model is established, and the mitigation capacity of dynamic voltage restorer (DVR) is taken as the optimization variable and the maximum users' benefit is taken as the objective. Considering the investment and loss of the two sides, the transformation benefit objective function and comprehensive transformation optimization model are established combined with the NPV method, and it is derived by using the chained agent genetic algorithm (CAGA). The simulation analysis in IEEE-30 system verifies the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Microgrid operation control technology based on lithium-ion capacitor
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: For microgrid with photovoltaic generation and hybrid energy storage system, if the impact load appears, the voltage and frequency fluctuation of the system will become greater due to the absence of large grid support, affecting the reliability and stability of power supply. To solve this problem, Lithium-ion capacitor with high power density characteristic is used to track and compensate the active and reactive currents of impact loads. In addition, model current predictive control method is applied to the control of Lithium Ion capacitor inverter. Through the simulation analysis, the voltage and frequency of system can fluctuate within permitted range after the hybrid energy storage tracked and compensated impact loads, which greatly ensures the system's transient stable operation. The experimental platform of distributed hybrid energy storage is constructed to verify the effectiveness of the model current predictive control method.

articleTitle: Accommodated capacity for wind and solar power under the background of supply side reform: Model and empirical study
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
