abstract: In order to adapt and lead the new norm of economic development, the structural reform of the supply side is a major strategic step in the face of the new situation of economic development both at home and abroad. The development of wind power, solar energy and other clean energy is the right direction of the energy supply side reform, and the characteristics of electricity production and consumption determine the central position of clean energy in the structural reform of the energy supply side. On the basis of summarizing the existing methods of evaluating the capacity of wind power (photovoltaic power station) consumption, this paper calculates the number of wind power (photovoltaic power station)consumption in the whole year by means of the balance of the whole cycle and the hourly power balance and the rational operation mode of pumped storage. The method calculates the change of the quantity of wind power (photovoltaic power station) consumption in the whole year in the case of different wind power(photovoltaic power station) installed capacity and determines the reasonable scale of wind power (photovoltaic power station) installed capacity, which can greatly improve the accuracy of wind power (photovoltaic power station) acceptance. Through the empirical test, it proves that this method has strong guiding significance for power grid planning and improves the consumption capacity of wind power (photovoltaic power station).

articleTitle: A design of rural intelligent household micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the reliability of power supply in China's rural areas and the poor quality of power, this paper designs a new household micro-id power supply system, which can widely absorb distributed energy, based on the characteristics of local distributed energy structure. Firstly, the distribution characteristics of the local renewable energy sources and load demand are accurately analyzed to determine the system structure and the capacity configuration of distributed generation. Then, analyze the spectrum of the output power of renewable energy. Based on the analysis, characteristics of energy storage unit and system constraints, determine the optimal capacity of energy storage unit. This system adopts hierarchical control mode, uses the upper scheduling control unit and a remote terminal to manage the whole system, and uses bi-directional inverter to made the micro-grid parallel in and cut smoothly. The design of the new rural household micro grid system is of great significance to the further development of micro-grid.

articleTitle: A novel convex combination of LMMN and RLS algorithms for power system parameter estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The ever growing usage of power electronic devices and non-linear loads in a power system is increasing current and voltage harmonics which are a major source of power quality deterioration. An essential step to mitigate the negative effects of harmonics is to design proper filtering which in turn requires an efficient parameter estimation of a measured power system signal. In this paper a novel convex combination of the least mean mixed norm (LMMN) and recursive least square (RLS) algorithms called RLMMN is proposed for harmonic, sub-harmonic and inter-harmonic amplitude and phase angle estimation of a distorted power system signal corrupted with a random Gaussian noise. The proposed RLMMN algorithm inherits the advantages of both algorithms to achieve fast convergence, better tracking and lower steady state estimation errors. The estimation performance is evaluated for static signal and abrupt amplitude drift condition. Three other algorithms reported in the literature are considered for judging the robustness of the proposed algorithm. From the simulation studies it is observed that the proposed RLMMN algorithm exhibits superior estimation performance in terms of estimation accuracy as compared to estimations obtained by LMS, RLS and LMMN algorithms under various SNR environments.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of distributed photovoltaic generation investment associated with urban energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The requirement of power supply and voltage quality was improved with the new-style urbanization. To reduce the poverty in some distressed areas, a lot of policies associated with photovoltaic generation investment were put forward to increase the distributed photovoltaic generation (PV) in rural areas. Therefore, it is necessary to study the influence of PV to power grid and the profit of different investment mode. Some typical construction cases are proposed to support the distributed PV in rural areas.

articleTitle: Research on eddy current loss of ‘Wet’ magnetic coupling
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Eddy current loss of the magnetic coupling in fluid medium which named `wet' situation is observed in this research. Numerical simulation of ANSYS is used to calculate and analyze eddy current loss in different fluid medium. The key equations of eddy current loss are based on the principle of magnetism. The model of `wet' magnetic coupling is established to analyze the eddy current loss produced by magnetic coupling and isolation sleeve on the basis of finite element theory. Additionally, effect of rotational speed and conductivity on eddy current loss is analyzed in the study. Several methods to reduce eddy current loss are put forward incidentally.

articleTitle: Research on commerical mode for load optimizing via power grid and information network integration
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the context of the development of smart grid in China and the large number of residents, it is very likely that the power grid will face the problem of regional power failure and the problem of power imbalance at the peak of the load. Control can mitigate the dangers of an emergency. For this reason, this paper discusses the direct control strategy based on load aggregation, and evaluates and prospects the direct load control under power failure.

articleTitle: An improved neural network method based on the differential evolution algorithm to predict the tidal level in the tidal power station
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Numerous methods have been used to extract energy from the sea. The character of tidal level makes it possible to predict. In order to obtain the energy more effectively, a highly precious method is demanded to predict the tidal level. In this paper, a hybrid method which combines the traditional neural network method and the differential evolution algorithm is proposed. By using this method, the ability of the global search are improved and the optimal weight values and the threshold values can be calculated through the neural network algorithm. These approximate optimal values obtained from the differential evolution algorithm are trained in the neural network, thus a more accurate solution can be achieved. In the end of this issue, the tidal prediction model is verified by the tidal data of the Qingdao harbor. The experimental results prove the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Impact of UPFC on distance protection in AC transmission system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, analytical and simulation results are carried out about the application of distance protection with the presence of the unified power flow controller (UPFC) in the AC system. Combined with the UPFC protection, the impact of UPFC on distance protection is analyzed under different operation conditions. The influence to the distance protection is bigger when the series unit remains in the system after fault occurs. The simulation results show the impact of UPFC on protection for different operation conditions and different fault locations.

articleTitle: The simulation study on line protection of HVDC transmission system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper introduces the causes of line fault and expounds traveling wave protection and the criterion of protection action. Then establishes the simulation model of HVDC transmission system based on PSCAD/EMTDC, by which the line fault under different transition resistance and fault distance are simulated. Combined with the actual configuration and setting value of the line protection to analyze, the results show that the sensitivity of the terminal grounding fault caused by the one side protection input become poor. Therefore, it is proved that the two station configuration protection mode chosen in this project is suitable for operational settings of line protection, and the line protection can be operated correctly in the event of a fault. The simulation results also verify the reliability of the line protection setting and provide technical support for the operation of the line protection.

articleTitle: Design of detection supporting system for smart substation maintenance crew
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper starts with an introduction of the defects of safety measures taken by traditional detection. Then, a scheme in which safety measures for detection can be automatically formed, is proposed. In the new scheme, the safety measures are graphically demonstrated, so that the maintenance crews can learn the measures easily. The paper presents the principles of detection safety measures, making of detection template library, and the logic of automatically forming detection safety measures. It is expected to provide ideologies and references for making detection safety measures for new generation smart substation.

articleTitle: Establishment of hybrid AC/DC system model and its characteristic research
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Based on the electromagnetic transient simulation software, which is called PSCAD/EMTDC, this paper establishes the detailed hybrid AC/DC system model, with UHVDC connected to the AC system through double circuit transmission lines. The converters are established by detailed models, and the generators are established with excitation and speed regulating systems. Dynamic properties of hybrid AC/DC system under different operation conditions are analyzed in this paper. The research results show that, the established hybrid AC/DC system model in this paper can reflect electromagnetic properties of different operation conditions, laying solid foundations for subsequent protection related issues in hybrid AC/DC system.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of suppressing disturbance of electric vehicle driving motor
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The state of the electric vehicle under the state of motion, the stability of its operating status, efficiency will be affected by the motor running status. The load disturbance of the motor will cause the output torque to fluctuate, which will cause the vehicle battery to generate the corresponding fluctuation. Based on the above analysis, through the establishment of permanent magnet synchronous motor loss fluctuations in the general model, based on the H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sup> control theory, complete vehicle power supply system almost interference decoupling control strategy. Through the analysis of the actual data, and the corresponding simulation results show that the control strategy to achieve a specific interference suppression, proved that the control strategy can be set almost interference decoupling.

articleTitle: Quantitative analysis method for electricity-saving benefit of area substations
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a quantitative analysis method for electricity-saving benefit of area substations to address the problem of calculating electricity-saving benefit of numerous and various substations. Initially, the electricity-saving index system which includes the basic property index sub system and the electrical property index sub system is designed, which can divide area substations into several categories according to their electricity-saving characteristics. Further, based on electricity using rules and operating characteristics of air-conditioning and lighting distributed in various typical substations, air-conditioning and lighting systems are divided into three and five classes, which greatly simplify the calculation of electricity-saving benefit. Then, taking into account the remanent value of equipment, electricity-saving rebuilding investment cost, and payback period etc., an electricity-saving benefit analysis method is designed. Finally, this paper takes seventeen 220kV substations as examples which shows that the method proposed is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: The value of accurate modeling of coal-fired units in promoting the use of wind power
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The penetration of wind power is increasing rapidly in recent years. However, due to the shortage of sufficient flexible resources, high proportion of wind power curtailment has been a serious problem in some power systems. For the power systems mainly consisting of coal-fired units, coal-fired units may have to take more responsibility to accommodate the uncertainty of wind power. This paper evaluates the importance of accurate modeling of coal-fired units in exerting the flexibility of coal-fired units. A compact and accurate coal-fired unit model is presented in this paper, which considers the startup and shutdown power trajectories of the coal-fired units. The proposed model is applied to the stochastic unit commitment with large-scale wind power integration. Numerical simulations have verified that accurate modeling of coal-fired units can better schedule the flexible resources provided by coal-fired units and can thus promote the use of wind power.

articleTitle: Summarization of construction planning method for electric vehicle charging station
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: On the basis of recent years relevant literature, combined with the relevant research results of electric vehicle charging station development status at home and abroad. The methods of the quantitative research are briefly analyzed for charging station construction of electric vehicle. The construction method of common model analysis and comparison of the charging station construction summed up the theory of city electric vehicle charging facilities layout planning, in order to provide a useful reference for future research. At the same time, it also introduces the user demand before charging station construction and the user satisfaction after charging station construction.

articleTitle: Optimal power flow algorithm based on self-adaptive filter-trust region method
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The Optimal Power Flow (OPF) problem for power systems could be expressed by a Non-Linear Programming (NLP) model, which is difficult to be solved. This study presents a practical algorithm to solve OPF through a successive linear programming (SLP), in which conventional power flow and linearized Sub-Problem (LSP) are solved by alternating iteration. A Self-Adaptive Filter-Trust Region (SAIFT) method is proposed to solve the LSP, in which the acceptance of the current iteration point is decided by a filter, and the step size is controlled by the trust region. The Wolfe linear search method is used to provide the direction of optimization when the consequence is dominated by filter. Furthermore, the linearization strategy of transformer ratio and the dynamic adjustment strategy of step size are proposed, which simplifies the formulation and improves the convergence of the algorithm. Case studies based on Ward-Hale 6-bus system demonstrate the efficacy of the new method in solving the OPF problems.

articleTitle: Energy balance based DC-link voltage control of grid tied battery connected multistage bidirectional PV inverter system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: An energy balance algorithm is desirable for the DC-link voltage control of Grid tied Battery connected bidirectional Photovoltaic (PV) inverter system. The system must satisfy the requirements of Battery and the DC-bus voltage requirements. This paper proposes an energy balance based algorithm to stabilize the voltage across the DC-link capacitor which will automatically stabilizes the DC-bus voltage. The proposed energy balance algorithm generates the reference Grid current for current control algorithm which controls the inverter to inject sine wave current into the Grid. Thus, the proposed algorithms accordingly balance the voltage across the DC-link capacitor and controls the inverter to inject sine wave current into the Grid. The system shows an excellent performance based on the proposed algorithms which includes tracking accuracy, tracking speed, settling time and overshoot, which can be seen in the simulation results.

articleTitle: Explore the implementation path of the world — Class city power supply network
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper introduces the essential elements of the world's first-rate urban power supply network, and gives the indexes of the first class urban power supply network by collecting domestic and foreign city information. By comparing the indexes of domestic and foreign major cities, find out the difference of domestic cities. Thus, the promotion plan supports the implementation path of the world's first-rate city power supply network.

articleTitle: Simulation studies of hole textured and planar microcrystalline silicon solar cell at different zenith angle
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Efficiency of solar cell greatly depends on its interaction with input solar irradiance. For highly efficient solar cell, absorption of input light should be maximum at all angles. Different surface texturing techniques like pyramid texturing, cone texturing, pillar texturing have been used to increase absorption of light in solar cell. Micro-hole Surface texturing is getting popular in absorption of solar radiation at higher zenith angle. In this paper, effect of varying zenith angle on hole textured solar cell's performance is studied. By varying zenith angle, input solar spectrum irradiance is changed which results in a change in the performance of solar cell. It has been observed that by increasing zenith angle, efficiency of solar cell decreases due to decrease in input spectrum irradiance and less absorption of light from surface. Paper also presents a comparison of plane surface solar cell and the hole textured solar cell. Hole textured solar cell shows better performance than the plane surface solar cell at normal angle of incidence. The difference in the performance of both types of solar cell becomes more pronounced with the increase in the zenith angle.

articleTitle: Research and design of voltage source with arbitrary waveform and multiple output
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Simulate and output signal by Power system real time digital simulation system, through the power source to amplify the signals of voltage and current, generate two times voltage and current signal of simulated grid scenario, inject the relay protection equipment to be tested. Current common power source can only output a single sinusoidal signal. In order to meet the requirements of the performance verification of this kind of equipment, a voltage source with multiple outputs and arbitrary waveforms is designed. The system is divided into two parts, boost and full-bridge inverter. A current controlled chip UC3843 to stabilize the output voltage is used in the boost and the frequency multiplication SPWM modulation and effective PI regulation are adopted in full-bridge inverter to ensure low output distortion rate and fast dynamic response capability. Each output LC low-pass filter is designed, so that the effective information of reference signal falls in the frequency band. Simulation experiments are carried out by using Matlab/Simulink, the results show that the quality of the output waveform is good and the dynamic response speed is fast. The design and analysis is correct and the performance of the system reaches the design goals.

articleTitle: Capacity credit evaluation of grid-connected photovoltaic generation based on improved particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to assess the contribution of photovoltaic generation (PV) to distribution network, this paper presents a capacity credit evaluation method in the power side and load side. Firstly, the sequential Monte Carlo method is used to calculate the loss of load expectation (LOLE), which keeps the sequential information of units output. On this basis, an improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to solve the capacity confidence of grid-connected PV, with the target of unchanged system reliability before and after PV connects with the grid. Consequently, the effectiveness of proved evaluation method is verified through the simulation on IEEE-RTS79 system. And the simulation results show that the confidence level in the power side and load side have the same trend with the increase of PV permeability.

articleTitle: Maximum photovoltaic access capacity considering voltage deviation
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Distributed PV has developed rapidly with the advantages of less geographical limit, large capacity, cleanness and pollution-free. And the increasing grid-connected PV capacity also causes an important impact on the voltage of distribution network. Aimed at the maximum photovoltaic access capacity, this paper studied two typical topologies of open distribution network and closed distribution network. Considering the line loss, the voltage of distribution network connected with PV was deduced. Then, this paper analyzed the maximum access capacity of different topologies and different access methods considering voltage deviation. Finally, some suggestions were proposed for the location and capacity of distributed PV.

articleTitle: Research on the random wind power integration based on modular multilevel flexible DC transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power technology, the scale of the wind farm is getting bigger and bigger, and the wind power grid connected technology has entered a new stage. However, wind power has the characteristics of intermittent and uncontrollable, the use of AC transmission requires a large number of reactive power compensation devices, the use of traditional DC transmission needs to put a lot of filtering devices and is easy to fail to change the phase. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the method of grid connected of wind farm. The MMC-HVDC technology based on the modular multilevel converter has large capacity, be independent to control active and reactive power, be stability of the AC bus voltage and easy to form multiterminal DC system, etc. It is very suitable for grid connected of large wind farm and is widely used in wind power integration.

articleTitle: Synchronized estimation of NOx emission and reheat steam temperature via a multiple output version of nonlinear PLS
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Recently, the unit is usually required to run in large scale load ranges with low NOx emission, in particular in low load condition. This phenomenon inevitably leads to difficulties in controlling reheat steam temperature. Therefore, it is imperative to estimate NOx emission and reheat steam temperature synchronously in thermal power plants. This paper aims to establish a synchronized method used to estimate NOx emission and reheat steam temperature simultaneously via a new version of nonlinear partial least squares (NPLS) algorithm with multiple outputs. An experiment is conducted to validate the performance of the synchronized method. The experimental results show that such synchronized method has appropriate approximate and predictive accuracies when appropriate parameters can be assigned.

articleTitle: Study on feasibility and method of live replacement of 110kV isolators
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Although the fault rate of isolators of 110kV substations is high, currently only power-off overhaul is available. The complex operation and too long overhaul time reduce reliability of system power supply so it is in urgent need to study the method of live replacing isolators. In this paper, the live replacement method of 110kV isolators was studied, the operating process was subjected to simulated analysis via the ATP-EMTP software, and at the same time the safe distance of the operating process was studied, so as to verify the feasibility of the method. Furthermore, a set of diversion line insulation lifting device was developed according to site demand. The diversion line supporting lifter developed in this paper has operation reliability, strong applicability and operation convenience. The project of live replacement of 110kV isolators has considerable economic and social benefit, and is suitable for being popularized nationwide.

articleTitle: Study and validation of power generation predicting based on degradation rate of PV module in 25 years
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: During the feasibility study stage, it is very important to efficiently and accurately estimate the energy production of photovoltaic (PV) power station, which will directly affect the revenue forecast of the project. At present, there are several ways to estimate the power generation, but most of them are very complex and time consuming. In this paper we propose a new forecasting method based on the power degradation rate of PV module is proposed. In this method, the power generation for the first year is first calculated and then the generation for the next 24 years is estimated based on the amount of the first year. During the calculation, the DC/AC line loss, matching loss of PV string and other influence factors is regarded as a constant. The method investigated in this study may be a promising and feasible way for the yield prediction, and to a certain extent, this method can improve the precision and reduce the complexing of generation forecast.

articleTitle: Automatic design for power frequency voltage withstand system
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Power frequency voltage withstand system is the most effective way to test the electrical equipment. It is widely used in power system to test electrical equipment. It is designed and achieved by LabVIEW for intelligent control. The system uses virtual instrument programming LabVIEW 2015 platform to design interactive interface of human-computer. The system has the function of test type choosing, test parameter setting and real-time monitoring. It develops real-time(RT) data acquisition system, and completes the design of voltage and current signal conditioning circuit. In the meanwhile, multisim software is used to simulate the voltage and current signal conditioning circuit. Designing protection circuit of overpressure and overcurrent to improve system reliability, and the hardware control platform of electric control cabinet have been realized. Finally, through on-site debugging, it is proved that the system can complete standardized test procedure of 1000MVA coil withstand voltage test, and it can achieve the fast overvoltage, overload, and overcurrent protection. In this way, it can improve the operation efficiency and realize full use of energy.

articleTitle: Flux weakening control for torque and efficiency optimization of a vector controlled four switch three phase inverter fed induction motor drive
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel flux weakening control scheme for Four Switch Three Phase Inverter (FSTPI) drive to improve the speed-torque characteristics and motor efficiency in the high-speed region. In the proposed scheme, a method to calculate the optimal flux reference and slip frequency command for the high-speed region is explained in detail. The proposed method is verified by experiment and results show an improvement in the maximum attainable torque and motor efficiency of the drive.

articleTitle: RTDS simulation for HVDC solid state transformer with photovoltaic cells when low voltage ride through base on dual control theory
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Photovoltaic cells is more efficient when connecting the power grid by Discrete Current than Alternative Current. HVDC-SST is a key device by DC connection. However, Low voltage Ride Through(LVRT) often occurs in the photovoltaic fields. To solve the overcurrent problem while LVRT occurs, this paper involved a dual control strategy for each DAB unit of the HVDC-SST. There is an inverter side and a rectifier side in a DAB unit. In this paper, the inverter side of each DAB unit was under constant current hysteresis control, the rectifier side was under constant voltage PI control. And then it verified the dual control method by RTDS simulation, the results show that that the control algorithm can reduce the current when LVRT occurs, so the strategy can meet the requirement of low voltage.

articleTitle: Research on communication protocol supporting large scale load group control
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem caused by UHV emergency fault of large-scale power grid, it is necessary to control the large-scale user load group to fill the power supply gap. Due to the lack of the corresponding communication protocol to support the control of large-scale load group, this paper studied the existing Internet and smart grid related communication protocol to establish a XMPP-based LSLGC communication protocol in the application layer. Registration, Report, Event and Opt four processes are selected to support large-scale load group control. Also, the corresponding control mechanism is studied.

articleTitle: Equivalent three-phase short circuit calculation method based on static equivalence considering grounding branches
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the fast development of modern interconnected power systems, the impact of external neighboring network on internal network becomes ever-increasingly important and cannot be ignored in three-phase short circuit calculation. Static equivalent methods can retain the essential information of original external neighboring network. However, existing equivalent methods still have many insufficiencies. In this paper, a static equivalent model considering grounding branches of the external network is proposed to improve the equivalence accuracy of three-phase short circuit calculation. In this model, the equivalent grounding branches are derived according to the weighted partial derivatives of border node voltages with respect to the grounding branches. Based on the proposed equivalent model, a new equivalent three-phase short circuit calculation method is presented to achieve high calculation accuracy for interconnected power systems. The simulation results of the IEEE 14-bus system demonstrate the effectiveness and correctness of the proposed model and method.

articleTitle: Research on automatic demand response simulation service architecture
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Automatic demand response simulation is of great significance for simulation deduction, personnel training and scientific research verification. The automatic requirement response simulation system consists of requirement response service system, demand response aggregation system and demand response terminal. The main participants in the system include demand response service managers, demand response aggregators, and industrial, commercial and resident users involved in the response. Based on the demand response service and service model research and the participation of the main body, the paper puts forward the automatic demand response simulation service architecture which is adapted to the gradual release of the electricity sales market to promote the efficient and orderly development of demand response.

articleTitle: On the empirical k-factor in ice accretion on wind turbines: A numerical study
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: An investigation of empirical k-factor, describing the ratio of ice accretion on reference collector (cylinder) and wind turbine blade has been performed with a series of numerical simulations, and analytical calculations. The results show that k-factor can vary to a degree, depending on a number of different parameters. These include the effect of object's geometry, droplet distribution spectrum on ice accretion and collision efficiencies, different ambient conditions, experienced by both the reference collector and wind turbine blade, which can lead to different ice growth regimes. Further numerical experimentations and actual validation of the concepts is warranted. Considering the complexity of the process in question, there is a significant chance that ice accretion on a wind turbine blade, when compared to ice accretion of reference cylinder cannot be explained using simple, dimensionless ratio.

articleTitle: Research on zero-sequence current calculation method for VSC and circulation current of parallel VSC
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Renewable energy usually adopts flexible grid connection technology which based on three-phase voltage source converter (VSC) and droop control to connect with the distribution. Zero-sequence current of three-phase VSC has influence on on-state loss current and zero-sequence circulating current. Fourier decomposition of zero-sequence voltage of three-phase VSC at valve side based on bessel function was analyzed. Steady-state zero-sequence equivalent circuit of three-phase VSC based on equivalent model of modulation was derived, and the calculation method of zero-sequence current for VSC was obtained. Simulation model of three-phase VSC using set electrical parameters was built; value of zero-sequence current at the switching frequency was obtained based on simulation model while modulation depth changed. Meanwhile, value of zero-sequence current at the switching frequency was obtained based on calculation method mentioned in this article. Correctness of proposed calculation method was verified by comparison of two methods. In addition, the trend of main components of zero-sequence current of VSC and zero-sequence circulating current increment of parallel VSC were analyzed while modulation depth changed, conclusions were consistent with the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Topology identification in distribution network based on power injection measurements
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Erroneous remote signal in distribution supervisory control and data acquisition (DSCADA) decreases reliability of distribution network topology which is identified based on remote signaling data of DSCADA. A new method of topology identification is proposed to solve this problem, which adopts multi-sampling of power injections by micro synchronous phasor measurement unit (μPMU) to construct the variance model of the branch voltage deviation. The Kruskal algorithm is used to obtain the minimum spanning tree with the variance of the branch voltage deviation as the line weight to achieve the identification of operation topology structure of distribution network, and then the influence of the sampling times of the power injection data and the complexity of the distribution network on the identification errors is analyzed. The example shows that the algorithm has good reliability and practicability for the topology identification in distribution network.

articleTitle: Multi-source optimal schedule of power system considering smoothing effect of wind and photovoltaic sources
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The integration of extensive wind and solar power into power system brings great threat to the safe and stable operation of the grid, as well as decreasing the economy of unit commitment. In this paper, a multi-source optimal schedule of power system considering smoothing effect of wind and photovoltaic sources is proposed to alleviate the adverse effect of wind and solar power and to realize the economic operation. The cluster composed of six wind power plants and three photovoltaic plants in Portland of America is adopted as the study objective. Firstly, index for assessing smoothing effect is proposed and the influence factors of smoothing effect are analyzed. Secondly, six typical weather patterns are identified based on the power output fluctuation of the wind and solar. Thirdly, a multi-source complementary double layer optimal scheduling model is established which takes different weather types into consideration. Finally, case study shows that the model can efficiently increase the economy of unit commitment and stabilize the power system.

articleTitle: Alternating iterative method for congestion management of microgrid integrated distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The distributed generations (DGs) are connected to medium or low level distribution network, and one of common ways to integrate these resources is to resort the so-called microgrid (MG) application. Yet, the high penetration of DGs, thus the MGs may incur the congestion of distribution network during operation. To address this issue, this paper proposes an alternating iterative method to solve the congestion management problem of the distribution network when multiple MGs are integrated. The problem is formulated as a constrained optimization problem with its objective being optimizing the generation cost while respecting the hard constraints imposed by both the MGs and distribution network. The formulated problem is then solved through an alternating iterative method wherein the distribution network and MGs alternatively optimize their own objective functions towards to the optimal solution of the original problem. Case studies with a 5-bus distribution system and the modified IEEE-13 bus system demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration of the segmented switch in complex multi-interconnected feeder considering branch layer and different reliability requirements
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The segmentation of line is one of the significant methods to improve the reliability of power supply. However, the distribution network planning still lack of scientific and systematic guidance for the segmentation of line. For the sake of the present situation that the actual planning is still empirical, a new method of optimal segmentation is proposed in this paper. Considering the characteristics of multiple interconnecting feeders with branch line, and a mathematical description of line branch faults is given. A mixed integer linear programming model based on The Flow of Failure Rate is constructed, which is applicable to the current mainstream overhead line and cable connection mode of the typical and complex line. The general solver is used directly to obtain the optimal number of segments and the location of the segments to meet the established reliability requirements under the actual planning. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by comparing with the segmented methods recommended by the current guidelines.

articleTitle: A simple wall function for complex atmospheric boundary layer and its application in wind energy
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A wall function suitable for the computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation of the Atmospheric Boundary Layer (ABL) is developed. This wall function is an improvement of the standard log law but has a unified formula spanning the whole turbulent boundary layer. By modifying a compressible heat transfer wall function, the ability of this wall function is extended to the ABL problems. Hence the ground effects such as heat transfer, pressure gradient can be included in the wall function. The method of introducing the roughness into this king of wall function is also discussed. Several cases including not only the typical turbulent flat plate but also some practically complex ones have been computed as verification of the wall function. The results show that the wall function produces modification to the turbulence values near the boundary, leading to an upgrade of the accuracy especially when the atmospheric boundary effects exist. The impact of these effects on the boundary layer indicates that they are unelectable for complex ABL flow. Besides, this wall function has good efficiency and strong robustness thus it can be applied as a boundary condition into the wind farm simulation for wind energy.

articleTitle: Evaluation for distributed photovoltaic generation system efficiency
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Large-scale popularization and integration of distributed photovoltaic generation has proposed higher requirements for the evaluation and promotion of photovoltaic generation system efficiency. In this paper, the efficiency evaluation index system of photovoltaic generation system is established based on five aspects: natural resources, electricity, consumption, equipment operation level and economic benefit. The calculation methods of photovoltaic generation system efficiency are presented. Afterwards, an evaluation methodology of distributed photovoltaic generation system efficiency is developed, which is based on the Standard Deviation and the Grey Correlation Determines evaluating the generation efficiency of different sites at the same time, and the generation efficiency of a single station at different time periods. Based on the evaluation results, this paper analyzes the efficiency of distributed photovoltaic generation stations in the northeastern China as a case study. In case of low efficiency at some time periods and sites, the corresponding promotion strategies are discussed to improve the system efficiency and to ensure the maximum efficiency of generation operation.

articleTitle: Evaluation on business model of smart grid value-added service
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: One complete evaluation system of business model of smart grid value-added service has been proposed in this paper. For the first time, the DAE-TOPSIS method and the computational analysis model are applied to the evaluation field of the smart grid value-added service and its business model. Firstly, the 3-level index evaluation system of business model of smart grid value-added service is built on the basis of BSC theory and corporate ecology theory; secondly, the weights of evaluation indexes at all levels are determined in a way that combines AHP method and entropy weight method; thirdly, the initial values of quantitative and qualitative indexes are acquired according to the actual data and Delphi method. On the basis of above, the TOPSIS method is used to evaluate the business model of smart grid value-added service; finally, the effectiveness of the scheme proposed in this paper is verified through comprehensive evaluation and analysis on actual electric vehicle charging and switching business model and vehicle networking platform business model in the business areas that have been or are about to be carried out. The evaluation system of the smart grid value-added service business model established in this paper provides strong support for the decision-making of power enterprises that develop smart grid business and the construction of smart grid and plays a significant role in guiding its healthy development.

articleTitle: “FIVE A” synthetical evaluation method for power quality assessment in new energy power
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the continuous increase of the proportion of new energy power supply, changing of the ways in using power, the rapid development of power grid structures, the increase of important power supply nodes, evaluation by measuring in worksite is not suitable for now. In the same time, there is also an urgently need for new method to assess power quality of new energy power roundly and quickly. This article analyzed several evaluation methods of assessing power quality in used, then we make a deep research about the characteristics in new energy power. At last, we put forward a new power quality synthetical evaluation method called “FIVE A” assessment, which is based on the unique power quality parameters of new energy power. This method is established by five elements, which are: harmonic voltage, harmonic current, voltage change, power change and power prediction, all these elements constitute a new system to evaluate power quality for new energy all sidedly in a short time.

articleTitle: Lowering the sintering temperature of low-temperature solid oxide fuel cells with Sm3+ and Nd3+ co-doped ceria electrolyte
publicationTitle: 2017 2nd International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Low-temperature solid oxide fuel cell with co-doped ceria electrolyte is a promising high efficient and cost-effective power conversion device, which needs rapid progress. One of the main issues is high sintering temperatures (1500-1600°C), increasing difficulty and cost in the cell fabrication process. To lower the sintering temperature, Fe has been evaluated as a sintering aid for Sm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> co-doped ceria electrolyte. The reduction in sintering temperature between Sm<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Nd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Ce<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.79</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.01</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-δ</sub> and Sm<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Nd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Ce<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub> O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-δ</sub> is as much as 250°. The Sm<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Nd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Ce<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.79</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.01</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-δ</sub> sintered at an optimal sintering temperature of 1250 °C exhibits the highest grain-boundary conductivity and relative density, which is much higher than that of Sm<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Nd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Ce<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</sub> O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-δ</sub>. The doping of Fe increases both bulk conductivity and grain boundary conductivity of the SNDC electrolyte. An integrated single cell with Sm<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Nd<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>Ce<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.79</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.01</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-δ</sub> electrolyte exhibits a high maximum power density of 458 mWcm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> at 650°C, which is 20-30% higher than previous reports.
